name: read-only-proof-lacks-a-negative-control
body: The plan-verify read-only proof pins that verify succeeds while another read-only handle is held, but does not independently demonstrate a read-write open would fail (lbug's handle classes may not conflict on this fixture), so the exclusive-class claim rests on the production code using `open_read_only`; its terminal-corrupt arm also asserts the refusal's cause by containment against the same snapshot rather than byte-pinning it, because lbug's open/read error wording is not stable across engine versions. Add a negative control if a read-write conflict becomes observable; tighten to an exact cause clause only if the engine error text becomes pinned.
